chunks: Ali, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'It is from the nobility of a man that he should make his provisions good when he sets out on a journey.'

key_terms.زَادَهُ: his provisions or supplies for a journey

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about the nobility of a man regarding his travel provisions?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) links personal nobility (*sharaf*) to the quality of one's travel provisions, emphasizing that dignified conduct extends to practical preparedness. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and the spiritual significance of treating one's journey as an act of worship, ensuring that even mundane preparations are performed with excellence (*ihsan*).
